//eBay: Shipped defaults use the OmniCard eBay token broker (tools/ebay-broker): AppId, RuName and BrokerUrl are not secret, and CertId stays blank because the broker holds it. Environment (sandbox|production) must match the broker's keyset. To use your own keyset instead, set AppId/CertId/RuName/Environment (a CertId disables the broker); its RuName's accepted URL can stay eBay's default (Settings > eBay lets you paste the address) or point at https://<host>/api/ebay/callback. Leave AppId blank to keep eBay disabled (listing operations no-op).
